title: 第1章 合欢宗宗主第2章众目睽睽
slug: 脸盲宗主她又抓错人了
content_zh:
谁能想到，一个堂堂的现代女大学生，竟在一觉醒来之后。
成了这灵界之中以行事荒淫无忌而声名远播的合欢宗宗主。
原身不知从何处搜罗来了一本号称顶级的功法。
急于求成之下强行修炼，却不幸走火入魔，直接落得个魂飞魄散的下场！
而来自异世的她，便是在这般情形下穿越而来，占据了这具已然无主的躯壳。
最重要的是，她竟完整地继承了原身所有的修为！
那可是化神期的修为！！
放眼如今的灵界，明面上也仅有两位化神期大能。
除了她，另一位则一直处于闭关之中，不问世事。
这变相说明了，现下的灵界只有她唯一一个化神期修士了。
这感觉真是……
太爽了！！！
“桀桀桀桀桀桀桀桀！！”
当左护法常潇步入殿中时，听到的就是这一阵堪称恐怖的笑声。
自一个月前宗主从闭关中出来，性情便大为改变。
她会发出这般笑声，令人捉摸不透。
搞得近来他们这些下属皆是提心吊胆，苦不堪言。
总忧心下一秒宗主便会因何不满而骤然发难。
其实，从前的宗主性情也是阴晴不定
且经常有将看不顺眼之人随手爆成血雾的残暴癖好。

相较之下，如今的宗主虽然同样让人难以揣测
但至少……不似以往那般嗜血残暴了。
想到这里，常潇连忙低低清了清嗓子，出声提醒。
随即，他便看到原本慵懒歪着的宗主
迅速整理了一下略显凌乱的衣襟，端坐起身，脸上甚至掠过一丝……心虚。
其实，现在这样的宗主，倒也挺不错的。
而且……
宗主自这次闭关出来后，样貌和之前简直判若两人。
之前的宗主只能算得上好看。
但现在的宗主……其容貌可以算得上修真界第一。
就刚才宗主看过来的那一眼，自己的心中就出现了一丝波动……
“之前嘱咐你们去查的事情，可有结果了？”
一道柔软中带着几分清冷的声音在大殿中响起。
常潇连忙上前一步，袖袍轻挥，一幅卷轴，便在半空中徐徐展开。
“回禀主上，此人就是灵界的第一美男。”
“请主上过目。”
前世的她，从未谈过恋爱。
如今一朝穿越，竟成了修真界名副其实的顶尖人物
尽管所属阵营的名声不那么友好。
但至少，她拥有了现在灵界中最顶尖的战力。

如果抓来一位美男子来到身边。
朝夕相对，日久生情，也是件合情合理的事情吧？
白露素手轻扬，那画卷便似被无形丝线牵引，缓缓飞至她面前。
画中之人，身着素雅白袍，如墨黑发被一支碧色玉簪一丝不苟地绾于头顶。
content_en:
Who would have thought that a dignified modern female college student would wake up like this.
He became the leader of the Hehuan Sect who was famous for his licentious behavior in the spiritual world.
The original body did not know where to collect a so-called top-notch martial arts book.
He was eager to achieve success and forced himself to practice, but unfortunately he went crazy and ended up in a state of complete disarray!
And she, who came from another world, came through time under such circumstances and took over this body that had no owner.
The most important thing is that she has completely inherited all the cultivation skills of her original body!
That is the cultivation level of the God Transformation Stage! !
Looking at today's spiritual world, there are only two great masters in the divine transformation stage.
Except for her, the other one has been in seclusion and does not care about the world.
This disguise shows that she is the only monk in the spiritual transformation stage in the spiritual world now.
This feels really...
So cool! ! !
"Jie Jie Jie Jie Jie Jie Jie Jie!!"
When Protector Zuo Chang Xiao walked into the hall, what he heard was this burst of terrifying laughter.
Since the sect master came out of seclusion a month ago, his temperament has changed greatly.
She would laugh like this, it was unpredictable.
As a result, their subordinates have been on tenterhooks and miserable lately.
I am always worried that the next second the sect leader will suddenly attack due to dissatisfaction.
In fact, the temperament of the former sect master was also unstable.
And he often has a cruel habit of randomly exploding those he dislikes into blood mist.
In comparison, although today’s sect leader is equally difficult to predict,
But at least... it's not as bloodthirsty and cruel as before.
Thinking of this, Chang Xiao quickly cleared his throat and warned.
Immediately, he saw the sect leader who was leaning lazily
He quickly tidied up his slightly messy clothes and sat up, with even a hint of... guilt on his face.
In fact, the current sect master is quite good.
And...
After the sect leader came out of seclusion this time, he looked completely different from before.
The previous sect master could only be considered good-looking.
But the current sect leader... his appearance can be regarded as the best in the world of cultivation.
Just when the sect leader looked over, there was a slight fluctuation in his heart...
"Has there been any result on what I asked you to investigate before?"
A soft and somewhat cold voice sounded in the hall.
Chang Xiao quickly stepped forward, waved his sleeves and robe, and a scroll slowly unfolded in mid-air.
"Reporting to the Lord, this man is the most beautiful man in the spiritual world."
"Please, Lord, take a look."
In her previous life, she had never been in love.
Now, after traveling through time, he has become a veritable top figure in the world of cultivation.
Even though the faction they belong to has a less than friendly reputation.
But at least, she has the best combat power in the spiritual world.
If a handsome man is captured and comes to you.
It is also a reasonable thing to face each other day and night and develop love over time, right?
Bai Lusu raised her hand lightly, and the scroll seemed to be pulled by invisible threads and slowly flew to her.
The person in the painting is dressed in a simple and elegant white robe, with ink-black hair meticulously tied on the top of his head by a jade hairpin.
